spans.s: Immeasurable,Ⓒa.Ⓓameya, amita, apari-mARa, durmeya, mahat, bahu, ati pr.

Immediate,Ⓒa.ⒹanaMtara, avyavahita, niraM-tara, avyavaDAna.
Ⓑ
 2 tAtkAlika (kI f.), sadyaska, acira, SIGra; better by ‘i(mmediate)ly’.
Ⓑ
 3 sannihita, upasTita, Asanna, nikawa.
Ⓝ[Immediate]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹsadyaH, sapadyeva, samanaMtarameva, sapadi; tatkzaRAt, tatkAle, sadya eva, Jawiti, drAk, ASu, avilaMbitaM, acirAdeva; oft. by eva or mAtra; ‘i(mmediate) after he had spoken’ tasminnuktavatyeva; muktamAtre sAyake &c.
Immemorial,Ⓒa.ⒹasmArta, smaraRAtikrAMta, atiprAcIna, anAdi; ‘i(mmemorial) succession’ anAdiparaMparA; ‘from times i(mmemorial)’ anAdi-kAlAt, asmArtakAlAt.

Immense,Ⓒa.ⒹatyaMta, aparimeya, atimAtra, anaMta, aparimARa, amita, atimaryAda, durmeya; mahat, bfhat, su-ati-mahat, atibfhat.
Ⓝ[Immense]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹatyaMtaM, atimAtraM.
Ⓝ[Immens]ity,Ⓒs.ⒹAnaMtyaM, amitatA, aparimARatvaM, mahattvaM, sumahattvaM.
Ⓝ[Immens]urable,Ⓒa.ⒹSee Immeasurable.

Immerge, Immerse,Ⓒv. t.ⒹavagAh c., ni-masj c. (majjayati), Aplu c., jale praviS c.
Ⓝ[Immers]ed,Ⓒa.Ⓓmagna, ni-aBini-vizwa, vyApfta, lIna, Asakta, nizWa-para-tatpara- in comp.; See Fixed, Intent.
ⓃImmersion,Ⓒs.ⒹnimajjanaM, avagAhaH-hanaM, AplAvaH, snAnaM, aBi-zekaH.
Ⓑ
 2 magnatA, nizWA, tatparatA, aBiniveSaH.
